description.zh: 经典猜数字游戏。系统随机生成 1-100 之间的数字，用最少的次数猜中它。最佳记录会被自动保存。
description.en: Classic number guessing. The system picks a number between 1 and 100 - find it in as few tries as possible. Your best record is saved automatically.

controls.zh: 输入数字后点「猜！」或回车提交，系统给出冷热提示
controls.en: Type a number, press Guess or Enter; the game replies hot/cold
